method: Node VM with production entry/engine and native arcadeInput/arcadeAction. Mission entry/loadout fixtures only. Runtime play uses observable current targets, visible fields, keyboard/joystick movement, one Tab per decision, ordinary firing/missile/pulse. No HP, position, enemy removal or victory overrides; not a browser/device test.
